verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a self-hosted variant exists (Bitbucket Data Center/Server) and even offer migration tooling and trial credits from Data Center to Cloud, but the marketing emphasis is entirely on migrating customers away from self-hosting toward Bitbucket Cloud, with no evidence of AI-native tooling (Rovo, AI code reviewer, MCP server) being available in the self-hosted product. Missing for 10: documentation that AI features run in self-hosted/Data Center deployments, first-party self-hosting setup guides for AI workflows, and independent confirmation Data Center remains a fully supported long-term self-host option.
